💡 **suggestion** | CI

This hook has no row in `scripts/precommit-hook-descriptions.tsv`, so the 🐙 Code Quality summary renders it with a blank description (`echo "🧪 run_db_migrations script tests" | python3 scripts/precommit-hook-desc.py` prints an empty second column on this branch). Adding a row next to `rebaseline script tests` fixes it, e.g.:

```
run_db_migrations script tests	Self-test the migrations init-container exit code
```

🤖 *Review posted via /review-github-pr*

🧹 **nit** | Comments

Lines 9–10 describe the removed `a && b` code, which is history that fits the PR body better. What a reader of this file needs is why the exit codes are absorbed with `|| status=$?` instead of dropping `set -e`.

```suggestion
# The two migrations are independent: run both even if the first fails, then fail if either did.
# `|| status=$?` absorbs only these two exit codes, so `set -e` still guards the rest of the script.
```
